blocks.zh: 第二章：術語表
blocks.en: Chapter 2: Glossary

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Chapter

blocks.zh: 建立除菌過濾（Sterilizing Filtration）領域的核心術語知識庫，理解每個術語的精確定義
blocks.en: Build a core terminology base for sterilizing filtration and understand the precise definition of each term

blocks.zh: 區分容易混淆的相近術語，例如 Sterilization vs Sterilizing Filtration、Extractable vs Leachable、Diffusive Flow vs Forward Flow
blocks.en: Distinguish easily confused terms, such as Sterilization vs Sterilizing Filtration, Extractable vs Leachable, and Diffusive Flow vs Forward Flow

blocks.zh: 理解過濾系統中「上游 ↔ 下游」的方向概念，以及各種壓力術語的關係
blocks.en: Understand the "upstream ↔ downstream" orientation of a filtration system and how the various pressure terms relate to each other

blocks.zh: 掌握 Double Filtration 與 Redundant Filtration 的關鍵差異及其對完整性測試（Integrity Test）的影響
blocks.en: Master the key differences between Double Filtration and Redundant Filtration and their impact on integrity testing

blocks.zh: 熟悉 TR 26 中使用的標準縮寫，建立與後續章節的術語對應
blocks.en: Become familiar with the standard abbreviations used in TR 26 and link them to the terminology in later chapters

blocks.zh: 2.0 Glossary (A–C) — 術語表（A–C）
blocks.en: 2.0 Glossary (A–C)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Adsorption（吸附）vs Absorption（吸收）：這兩個詞在中文常被混淆。在過濾領域：
blocks.en: Adsorption vs Absorption: These two words are often confused. In filtration:

blocks.zh: Adsorption（吸附） — 物質附著在濾膜「表面」上，就像灰塵黏在牆壁上
blocks.en: Adsorption — a substance attaches to the "surface" of the membrane, like dust sticking to a wall

blocks.zh: Absorption（吸收） — 物質被「吸入」材料內部，就像海綿吸水
blocks.en: Absorption — a substance is taken "into" the interior of the material, like a sponge soaking up water

blocks.zh: 在除菌過濾中，吸附是重要的截留機制之一，但同時也可能導致產品中有效成分被濾膜「吸走」，這就是為什麼需要進行 Compatibility（相容性）測試的原因。
blocks.en: In sterilizing filtration, adsorption is one of the important retention mechanisms, but it can also cause active ingredients in the product to be "taken up" by the membrane. This is why Compatibility testing is required.

blocks.zh: Bacterial Retention Study（細菌截留試驗）：這是驗證除菌級濾膜最核心的實驗。它不只是「測試濾膜能不能擋住細菌」，而是要在模擬實際製程條件下（包括製程液體、壓力、溫度、過濾時間等）證明濾膜的截留能力。詳見 Section 6.0。
blocks.en: Bacterial Retention Study: This is the most central experiment for validating a sterilizing-grade filter. It is not just "testing whether the filter can stop bacteria"; it must demonstrate the filter's retention capability under simulated actual process conditions (including process fluid, pressure, temperature, filtration time, and so on). See Section 6.0 for details.

blocks.zh: Bioburden（生物負載）：指單位材料中微生物的種類和數量。這不僅僅是「有多少菌」，還包括「是什麼菌」— 因為不同微生物的大小和穿透能力不同，會影響除菌過濾的效能。
blocks.en: Bioburden: The types and number of microorganisms present per unit of material. It is not only "how many organisms" but also "which organisms", because different microorganisms differ in size and penetration ability, which affects sterilizing filtration performance.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 完整性測試（Integrity Test）就像出門前檢查門鎖：
blocks.en: An integrity test is like checking the door lock before you leave home:

blocks.zh: Bubble Point Test（泡點測試）的原理其實很直觀。想像一塊濕海綿 — 你從一邊吹氣，水填滿了所有小孔，空氣無法通過。當你逐漸加大氣壓，最終水會被從最大的孔洞中推出，你會看到氣泡開始穩定冒出。這個「臨界壓力」就是泡點。
blocks.en: The principle of the Bubble Point Test is actually quite intuitive. Imagine a wet sponge: you blow air from one side, water fills all the small pores, and air cannot get through. As you gradually raise the air pressure, water is eventually pushed out of the largest pore, and you see bubbles begin to stream out steadily. That "critical pressure" is the bubble point.

blocks.zh: 孔洞越小，需要的推動壓力就越大。所以泡點值越高 = 最大孔徑越小 = 濾膜越緻密。這就像測試門鎖 — 需要越大的力才能撬開，代表鎖越堅固。
blocks.en: The smaller the pore, the greater the pressure needed to push the liquid out. So a higher bubble point = a smaller maximum pore size = a tighter membrane. It is like testing a door lock: the more force needed to pry it open, the stronger the lock.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Capsule Filter vs Cartridge Filter — 關鍵差異：
blocks.en: Capsule Filter vs Cartridge Filter: key differences:

blocks.zh: Capsule Filter（囊式濾器）：自包含式設計，濾膜和外殼一體化，通常為一次性使用（Single-Use），免除清洗和滅菌的需求
blocks.en: Capsule Filter: A self-contained design with the membrane and housing integrated, usually single-use, which removes the need for cleaning and sterilization

blocks.zh: Cartridge Filter（濾芯式濾器）：需要搭配不鏽鋼外殼使用，可重複使用外殼，只更換濾芯
blocks.en: Cartridge Filter: Used with a stainless steel housing; the housing is reusable and only the cartridge is replaced

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，Capsule Filter 越來越受歡迎，因為它降低了交叉污染風險，也省去了清洗驗證的工作量。但成本較高，且產生更多廢棄物。選擇取決於你的產品組合和生產規模。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, capsule filters are increasingly popular because they lower the risk of cross-contamination and save the effort of cleaning validation. However, they cost more and generate more waste. The choice depends on your product portfolio and production scale.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 CPP 與過濾的關係
blocks.en: Key Notes: CPPs and Filtration

blocks.zh: Critical Process Parameter (CPP，關鍵製程參數)的定義非常重要：它是「對 CQA 有影響的製程參數」。在除菌過濾中，典型的 CPP 包括：
blocks.en: The definition of Critical Process Parameter (CPP) is very important: it is a "process parameter that has an impact on a CQA". In sterilizing filtration, typical CPPs include:

blocks.zh: 過濾壓差（Differential Pressure） — 過高可能導致濾膜變形或微生物穿透
blocks.en: Differential pressure — too high may cause membrane deformation or microbial penetration

blocks.zh: 過濾溫度 — 影響液體黏度和微生物活性
blocks.en: Filtration temperature — affects liquid viscosity and microbial activity

blocks.zh: 過濾時間 — 過長可能導致微生物在濾膜表面增殖
blocks.en: Filtration time — too long may allow microorganisms to proliferate on the membrane surface

blocks.zh: 生物負載水平 — 挑戰量過高可能超過濾膜的截留能力
blocks.en: Bioburden level — an excessive challenge level may exceed the retention capability of the membrane

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Bracketing Approach（括弧法）在除菌過濾驗證中如何應用？例如，如果你有三種不同批量（10L、50L、200L）的同一產品，你會測試哪些條件？
blocks.en: How is the Bracketing Approach applied in sterilizing filtration validation? For example, if you have the same product in three different batch sizes (10 L, 50 L, 200 L), which conditions would you test?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Compatibility（相容性）的定義強調「沒有不良交互作用」，而不是單純說「濾膜材質耐化學性」？想想這之間的差異。
blocks.en: Why does the definition of Compatibility emphasize "no adverse interaction" rather than simply saying the membrane material is "chemically resistant"? Think about the difference between the two.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 工廠決定從 Cartridge Filter 轉向 Capsule Filter，需要考慮哪些因素？列出至少五個面向。
blocks.en: Your CDMO site decides to move from cartridge filters to capsule filters. What factors need to be considered? List at least five aspects.

blocks.zh: 2.0 Glossary (D–F) — 術語表（D–F）
blocks.en: 2.0 Glossary (D–F)

blocks.zh: Double Filtration（雙重過濾）vs Redundant Filtration（冗餘過濾）：這是業界最容易混淆的兩個概念，必須精確區分。
blocks.en: Double Filtration vs Redundant Filtration: These are the two concepts most easily confused in the industry, and they must be distinguished precisely.

blocks.zh: Double Filtration（雙重過濾）：兩支濾器串聯，兩支都必須通過使用後完整性測試（Post-Use Integrity Test）。這代表單支濾器無法獨立達成除菌，必須兩支的截留效能「加在一起」才能確保無菌。
blocks.en: Double Filtration: Two filters in series, and both must pass the post-use integrity test. This means a single filter cannot achieve sterilization on its own; the retention performance of the two filters must be "added together" to ensure sterility.

blocks.zh: Redundant Filtration（冗餘過濾）：兩支濾器串聯，但只要一支通過完整性測試即可。第二支是「備援」，只在第一支失效時才需要發揮作用。
blocks.en: Redundant Filtration: Two filters in series, but it is sufficient for only one to pass the integrity test. The second is a "backup" and only needs to perform if the first fails.

blocks.zh: 這個區別對批次放行決策至關重要：在 Double Filtration 中，任一支濾器完整性測試失敗 = 批次可能不合格。在 Redundant Filtration 中，只有兩支都失敗才是問題。
blocks.en: This distinction is critical for batch disposition decisions: in Double Filtration, an integrity test failure of either filter = the batch may be unacceptable. In Redundant Filtration, it is a problem only if both fail.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Extractable vs Leachable
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Extractable vs Leachable

blocks.zh: Extractable（可萃取物）vs Leachable（可浸出物）：
blocks.en: Extractable vs Leachable:

blocks.zh: Extractable：在極端條件下（強力溶劑、高溫、長時間）從濾膜材料中「榨取」出來的化學物質 — 代表「最壞情況下可能釋出什麼」
blocks.en: Extractable: Chemical substances "forced out" of the membrane material under extreme conditions (strong solvents, high temperature, long duration), representing "what could possibly be released in the worst case"

blocks.zh: Leachable：在正常使用條件下從濾膜遷移到藥液中的化學物質 — 代表「實際上會接觸到產品的物質」
blocks.en: Leachable: Chemical substances that migrate from the membrane into the drug solution under normal use conditions, representing "what actually comes into contact with the product"

blocks.zh: E&L（Extractables & Leachables）研究是濾膜選型的必要步驟。Extractable 研究通常由濾膜供應商提供數據，而 Leachable 研究需要終端使用者用實際藥品進行。
blocks.en: E&L (Extractables & Leachables) studies are a necessary step in membrane selection. Extractables data are usually provided by the filter supplier, while leachables studies must be performed by the end user with the actual drug product.

blocks.zh: Fouling 就像水管堵塞：
blocks.en: Fouling is like a clogged water pipe:

blocks.zh: 想像你家廚房水龍頭下方的濾水器。剛安裝時水流很順暢（高 Flux），但隨著使用時間增加，濾芯上積累了越來越多的雜質。你會注意到兩個現象之一：
blocks.en: Imagine the water filter under your kitchen faucet. When first installed, the water flows smoothly (high flux), but as time goes on, more and more impurities build up on the filter element. You will notice one of two things:

blocks.zh: 如果水壓不變，水流變小了（Flux 下降）
blocks.en: If the water pressure stays the same, the flow becomes smaller (flux declines)

blocks.zh: 如果你希望水流維持不變，就需要加大水壓（Differential Pressure 上升）
blocks.en: If you want the flow to stay the same, you need to raise the water pressure (differential pressure rises)

blocks.zh: 這就是 Fouling（堵塞/阻塞）。在製藥過濾中，Fouling 不僅影響效率，還可能影響截留效能 — 因為堵塞可能導致局部壓力增高，潛在地影響濾膜的完整性。
blocks.en: This is fouling (clogging/blocking). In pharmaceutical filtration, fouling affects not only efficiency but may also affect retention performance, because clogging can cause local pressure increases, potentially affecting the integrity of the membrane.

blocks.zh: Flux vs Flow Rate — 不要搞混：
blocks.en: Flux vs Flow Rate: do not mix them up:

blocks.zh: Flow Rate（流速）：單位時間的流量體積（如 L/min）— 描述「整體流了多少」
blocks.en: Flow Rate: The volume of flow per unit time (e.g., L/min), describing "how much flows overall"

blocks.zh: Flux（通量）：單位膜面積的流速（如 L/m²/h）— 描述「每單位膜面積的效率」
blocks.en: Flux: The flow rate per unit membrane area (e.g., L/m²/h), describing "the efficiency per unit of membrane area"

blocks.zh: 為什麼這個區別重要？因為你可以透過增加 EFA（有效過濾面積）來提高 Flow Rate，但 Flux 不會因此改變。Flux 反映的是濾膜本身的通透性能和液體特性。在進行 Filterability Test（可過濾性測試）時，Flux 是評估濾膜選型的關鍵指標。
blocks.en: Why does this distinction matter? Because you can raise the flow rate by increasing the EFA (effective filtration area), but the flux does not change as a result. Flux reflects the permeability of the membrane itself and the characteristics of the liquid. In Filterability Testing, flux is the key indicator for evaluating membrane selection.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
Flux = Flow Rate / EFA

例如：
Flow Rate = 10 L/min
EFA = 0.5 m²

Flux = 10 / 0.5 = 20 L/m²/min
     = 1,200 L/m²/h (LMH)
blocks.en:
Flux = Flow Rate / EFA

Example:
Flow Rate = 10 L/min
EFA = 0.5 m²

Flux = 10 / 0.5 = 20 L/m²/min
     = 1,200 L/m²/h (LMH)

blocks.zh: LMH（Liters per square Meter per Hour）是業界最常用的通量單位。當你在評估不同供應商的濾膜時，比較 Flux 值比比較 Flow Rate 更有意義，因為它排除了膜面積差異的影響。
blocks.en: LMH (liters per square meter per hour) is the flux unit most commonly used in the industry. When evaluating membranes from different suppliers, comparing flux values is more meaningful than comparing flow rates, because it removes the effect of differences in membrane area.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠一個批次需要過濾 500L 藥液，Filterability Test 顯示 Flux 在該產品下為 800 LMH。如果你希望在 1 小時內完成過濾，至少需要多少 EFA？
blocks.en: Your site needs to filter 500 L of drug solution per batch, and the Filterability Test shows a flux of 800 LMH for this product. If you want to complete filtration within 1 hour, what is the minimum EFA required?

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下，你會選擇 Double Filtration 而非 Redundant Filtration？從風險管理角度思考。
blocks.en: Under what circumstances would you choose Double Filtration rather than Redundant Filtration? Think from a risk management perspective.

blocks.zh: Endotoxin（內毒素）為什麼會出現在術語表中？除菌過濾能去除內毒素嗎？如果不能，應該用什麼方法？
blocks.en: Why does Endotoxin appear in the glossary? Can sterilizing filtration remove endotoxin? If not, what method should be used?

blocks.zh: 2.0 Glossary (G–P) — 術語表（G–P）
blocks.en: 2.0 Glossary (G–P)

blocks.zh: Hydrophilic（親水性）vs Hydrophobic（疏水性）濾膜：這是選擇濾膜時最基本的分類。
blocks.en: Hydrophilic vs Hydrophobic membranes: This is the most basic classification when selecting a membrane.

blocks.zh: Hydrophilic 親水性濾膜：用於水溶液的過濾，包括大多數注射劑、眼藥水等。材質如 PVDF（聚偏二氟乙烯）、PES（聚醚碸）等。可以直接用水潤濕，低壓即可通過
blocks.en: Hydrophilic membranes: Used for filtering aqueous solutions, including most injectables, ophthalmic solutions, and so on. Materials include PVDF (polyvinylidene fluoride) and PES (polyethersulfone). They can be wetted directly with water and pass liquid at low pressure

blocks.zh: Hydrophobic 疏水性濾膜：用於氣體過濾（如通氣口過濾器）或非水溶劑的過濾。材質如 PTFE（聚四氟乙烯）。不能直接被水潤濕，需要先用低表面張力液體（如酒精）預潤濕
blocks.en: Hydrophobic membranes: Used for gas filtration (e.g., vent filters) or filtration of non-aqueous solvents. Materials include PTFE (polytetrafluoroethylene). They cannot be wetted directly by water and must first be pre-wetted with a low surface tension liquid (e.g., alcohol)

blocks.zh: 關鍵重點：親水性 / 疏水性決定了濾膜能過濾什麼液體、如何進行完整性測試（Integrity Test），以及用什麼潤濕液。
blocks.en: Key point: Whether a membrane is hydrophilic or hydrophobic determines which liquids it can filter, how the integrity test is performed, and which wetting fluid is used.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Integrity Test（完整性測試）
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Integrity Test

blocks.zh: 完整性測試的定義值得仔細咀嚼：「能與細菌截留能力相關聯的非破壞性物理測試」。幾個關鍵字：
blocks.en: The definition of an integrity test is worth careful reading: "a non-destructive physical test that can be correlated to bacterial retention capability". A few key words:

blocks.zh: 非破壞性 — 測試後濾膜仍可使用，不像 Bacterial Retention Study 會破壞濾膜
blocks.en: Non-destructive — the membrane can still be used after the test, unlike the Bacterial Retention Study, which destroys the membrane

blocks.zh: 物理測試 — 基於壓力、流量等物理參數，不是微生物學測試
blocks.en: Physical test — based on physical parameters such as pressure and flow, not a microbiological test

blocks.zh: 可關聯 — 測試結果必須經過驗證，與實際的細菌截留能力建立對應關係
blocks.en: Correlatable — the test result must be validated to establish a correspondence with actual bacterial retention capability

blocks.zh: 常見的完整性測試方法有三種：Bubble Point Test（泡點測試）、Diffusive Flow Test（擴散流測試）和 Water Intrusion Test（水侵入測試，用於疏水性濾膜）。
blocks.en: There are three common integrity test methods: the Bubble Point Test, the Diffusive Flow Test, and the Water Intrusion Test (used for hydrophobic membranes).

blocks.zh: 親水 vs 疏水就像雨衣的兩面：
blocks.en: Hydrophilic vs hydrophobic is like the two sides of a raincoat:

blocks.zh: 想像一件高品質的雨衣。外層（疏水性）讓雨水像珠子一樣滾落，不會浸透布料。內層（親水性）能吸收汗水，讓穿著者感覺乾爽。
blocks.en: Imagine a high-quality raincoat. The outer layer (hydrophobic) makes rain roll off in beads without soaking into the fabric. The inner layer (hydrophilic) absorbs sweat so the wearer feels dry.

blocks.zh: 除菌級濾膜也是同樣的原理。親水性濾膜「歡迎」水溶液通過（就像雨衣內層吸汗），而疏水性濾膜「排斥」水（就像雨衣外層擋雨），需要特殊處理才能讓水通過。
blocks.en: Sterilizing-grade membranes work on the same principle. A hydrophilic membrane "welcomes" aqueous solutions (like the inner layer of the raincoat absorbing sweat), while a hydrophobic membrane "repels" water (like the outer layer shedding rain) and needs special treatment before water can pass.

blocks.zh: 在實務中，你的注射劑（水溶液）幾乎都會選用親水性濾膜。疏水性濾膜則常用於製程中的通氣口過濾，防止外界微生物透過潮濕的空氣進入無菌區域。
blocks.en: In practice, your injectables (aqueous solutions) will almost always use hydrophilic membranes. Hydrophobic membranes are often used for vent filtration in the process, to keep outside microorganisms from entering the sterile area through humid air.

blocks.zh: Prefilter（前過濾器）的策略價值：
blocks.en: The strategic value of a Prefilter:

blocks.zh: 前過濾器被定義為「放置在除菌過濾器上游的任何過濾器」。看似簡單的定義，背後有重要的策略意義：
blocks.en: A prefilter is defined as "any filter placed upstream of a sterilizing filter". This seemingly simple definition carries important strategic meaning:

blocks.zh: 保護除菌級濾膜 — 先去除大顆粒和高生物負載，延長除菌級濾膜的使用壽命
blocks.en: Protects the sterilizing-grade membrane — removes large particles and high bioburden first, extending the service life of the sterilizing-grade membrane

blocks.zh: 降低過濾風險 — 減少除菌級濾膜上的截留負擔，降低穿透風險
blocks.en: Reduces filtration risk — lessens the retention load on the sterilizing-grade membrane and lowers the risk of penetration

blocks.zh: 降低成本 — 前過濾器通常比除菌級濾膜便宜很多
blocks.en: Reduces cost — prefilters are usually much cheaper than sterilizing-grade membranes

blocks.zh: CDMO 的實務建議：不要在前過濾器上省錢。一支好的前過濾器可以讓你的除菌級濾膜壽命延長 2-5 倍，整體過濾成本反而更低。
blocks.en: Practical advice for CDMOs: do not skimp on prefilters. A good prefilter can extend the life of your sterilizing-grade membrane by 2-5 times, and the overall filtration cost ends up lower.

blocks.zh: 你的製程中使用 Hydrophilic PES 濾膜進行水溶液除菌過濾。如果要對儲罐上的通氣口也安裝除菌級濾膜，你應該選擇什麼類型的濾膜？為什麼？
blocks.en: Your process uses a hydrophilic PES membrane for sterilizing filtration of an aqueous solution. If you also want to install a sterilizing-grade filter on the vent of the storage tank, what type of membrane should you choose, and why?

blocks.zh: Multi-Round Housing 可以增加 EFA，但在實務中使用多支濾芯並聯有什麼潛在的風險？想想完整性測試的複雜性。
blocks.en: A multi-round housing can increase the EFA, but what potential risks arise in practice from using multiple cartridges in parallel? Think about the complexity of integrity testing.

blocks.zh: Porosity（孔隙率）越高的濾膜，Flow Rate 通常越高，但這是否意味著截留效能一定更差？為什麼？
blocks.en: A membrane with higher porosity usually has a higher flow rate, but does this necessarily mean its retention performance is worse? Why?

blocks.zh: 2.0 Glossary (P–X) — 術語表（P–X）
blocks.en: 2.0 Glossary (P–X)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 壓力術語體系
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The Pressure Terminology System

blocks.zh: 過濾中的壓力術語容易令人混亂。讓我們建立一個清晰的架構：
blocks.en: Pressure terms in filtration can be confusing. Let us build a clear framework:

blocks.zh: Inlet Pressure（入口壓力）：進入濾器上游側的壓力 — 驅動液體通過濾膜的「推力」
blocks.en: Inlet Pressure: The pressure on the upstream side entering the filter, the "driving force" pushing liquid through the membrane

blocks.zh: Outlet Pressure（出口壓力）：離開濾器下游側的壓力
blocks.en: Outlet Pressure: The pressure on the downstream side leaving the filter

blocks.zh: Back Pressure（背壓）：下游管路限制造成的阻力
blocks.en: Back Pressure: Resistance caused by restrictions in the downstream piping

blocks.zh: Differential Pressure, ΔP（壓差）：Inlet Pressure - Outlet Pressure = 實際驅動過濾的有效壓力
blocks.en: Differential Pressure, ΔP: Inlet Pressure - Outlet Pressure = the effective pressure that actually drives filtration

blocks.zh: 記住公式：ΔP = Pinlet - Poutlet
blocks.en: Remember the formula: ΔP = Pinlet - Poutlet

blocks.zh: ΔP 越大，液體通過濾膜的速度越快，但也可能對濾膜造成更大的機械應力。大多數除菌級濾膜的最大允許 ΔP 在 3-5 bar 之間。
blocks.en: The larger the ΔP, the faster the liquid passes through the membrane, but the greater the mechanical stress that may be placed on the membrane. The maximum allowable ΔP for most sterilizing-grade membranes is between 3 and 5 bar.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Sterilization（滅菌）的機率本質
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The Probabilistic Nature of Sterilization

blocks.zh: 術語表中 Sterilization 的定義附帶了一個極為重要的備註：微生物的死亡遵循指數函數，存活機率可以降到非常低，但永遠不會等於零。
blocks.en: The glossary definition of Sterilization carries an extremely important note: microbial death follows an exponential function; the probability of survival can be reduced to a very low level, but it never equals zero.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼藥典使用 SAL（Sterility Assurance Level，無菌保證水平）的概念：
blocks.en: This is why the pharmacopoeias use the concept of SAL (Sterility Assurance Level):

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌（Terminal Sterilization）：SAL = 10<sup>-6</sup>（每一百萬個產品中可能有一個不是無菌的）
blocks.en: Terminal Sterilization: SAL = 10<sup>-6</sup> (one in a million products may be non-sterile)

blocks.zh: 除菌過濾（Sterilizing Filtration）：由於機制不同（截留而非殺滅），不直接使用 SAL 概念，而是透過 Bacterial Retention Study 加上完整性測試（Integrity Test）來確保濾膜的截留能力
blocks.en: Sterilizing Filtration: Because the mechanism is different (retention rather than kill), the SAL concept is not used directly; instead, the Bacterial Retention Study together with the Integrity Test is used to ensure the retention capability of the membrane

blocks.zh: 過濾的壓力系統就像自來水管路：
blocks.en: A filtration pressure system is like tap water plumbing:

blocks.zh: 想像你家的自來水系統。水塔的高度產生「入口壓力」，水龍頭前的閥門和管路彎折造成「背壓」。實際從水龍頭流出水的速度，取決於兩者之間的「壓差」。
blocks.en: Imagine the water system in your home. The height of the water tower creates the "inlet pressure", and the valve before the faucet and the bends in the pipe create the "back pressure". The speed at which water actually flows from the faucet depends on the "differential pressure" between the two.

blocks.zh: 如果你同時打開多個水龍頭（增加下游阻力 = 增加 Back Pressure），每個龍頭的水量就會變小。除菌過濾也一樣 — 如果下游管路有太多限制（如小口徑管路、關閉的閥門），ΔP 會改變，影響過濾效能。
blocks.en: If you open several faucets at once (increasing downstream resistance = increasing back pressure), the flow at each faucet becomes smaller. Sterilizing filtration is the same: if there are too many restrictions in the downstream piping (such as small-bore tubing or closed valves), ΔP will change and affect filtration performance.

blocks.zh: Redundant Filtration（冗餘過濾）的策略價值：
blocks.en: The strategic value of Redundant Filtration:

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，Redundant Filtration 是一種風險管理策略。當一個批次的藥品價值極高（如細胞治療產品或昂貴的生物製劑），如果唯一的除菌級濾膜在使用後完整性測試（Post-Use Integrity Test）失敗，整個批次可能需要報廢。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, Redundant Filtration is a risk management strategy. When a batch has very high product value (such as a cell therapy product or an expensive biologic), if the only sterilizing-grade membrane fails the post-use integrity test, the entire batch may have to be scrapped.

blocks.zh: 加裝第二支冗餘濾膜的成本可能只有幾千美元，但可以保護價值數十萬甚至數百萬美元的批次。
blocks.en: The cost of adding a second, redundant filter may be only a few thousand US dollars, yet it can protect a batch worth hundreds of thousands or even millions of dollars.

blocks.zh: Surface Tension（表面張力）的實務影響：如果你的藥品含有 Surfactant（界面活性劑），它會降低液體的表面張力，這可能影響完整性測試的結果 — 因為泡點值和擴散流值都與潤濕液的表面張力有關。這就是為什麼需要用產品濕潤的方式進行完整性測試驗證。
blocks.en: The practical impact of Surface Tension: If your drug product contains a surfactant, it lowers the surface tension of the liquid, which may affect the integrity test result, because both the bubble point and the diffusive flow values depend on the surface tension of the wetting fluid. This is why integrity test validation must be performed using product-wetted filters.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景 — 批次放行與完整性測試失敗：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: batch disposition and integrity test failure:

blocks.zh: 假設你正在為客戶生產一批價值 200 萬美元的單株抗體注射劑。過濾完成後，除菌級濾膜的使用後完整性測試（Post-Use Integrity Test）失敗了。
blocks.en: Suppose you are manufacturing a batch of monoclonal antibody injectable worth US$2 million for a client. After filtration, the post-use integrity test of the sterilizing-grade membrane fails.

blocks.zh: 如果你只有單一濾膜：這批藥可能需要報廢或進行偏差調查，損失慘重
blocks.en: If you have only a single filter: The batch may have to be scrapped or subjected to a deviation investigation, with heavy losses

blocks.zh: 如果你有 Redundant Filtration：第二支濾膜通過完整性測試，批次仍可放行，同時啟動偏差調查了解第一支濾膜為何失敗
blocks.en: If you have Redundant Filtration: The second filter passes the integrity test, so the batch can still be released, while a deviation investigation is started to understand why the first filter failed

blocks.zh: 這就是 Validation（驗證）定義中「高度保證」的實際含義 — 不是 100% 的絕對保證，而是透過系統性的策略將風險降到可接受的水平。
blocks.en: This is the practical meaning of "high degree of assurance" in the definition of Validation: not an absolute 100% guarantee, but reducing risk to an acceptable level through a systematic strategy.

blocks.zh: Sterilization 的定義指出「存活機率可以降到非常低但永遠不等於零」。那為什麼我們還說「無菌產品」？這個表述在科學上準確嗎？
blocks.en: The definition of Sterilization states that "the probability of survival can be reduced to a very low level but never equals zero". Then why do we still say "sterile product"? Is this expression scientifically accurate?

blocks.zh: 你的製程藥液含有 0.05% Polysorbate 80（一種常用的界面活性劑）。這對完整性測試會有什麼影響？你會如何處理？
blocks.en: Your process drug solution contains 0.05% Polysorbate 80 (a commonly used surfactant). What impact would this have on the integrity test, and how would you handle it?

blocks.zh: Serial Filtration、Double Filtration 和 Redundant Filtration 這三者之間的包含關係是什麼？試著畫出一個邏輯關係圖。
blocks.en: What are the inclusion relationships among Serial Filtration, Double Filtration, and Redundant Filtration? Try drawing a logic diagram.

blocks.zh: 2.1 Abbreviations — 縮寫表
blocks.en: 2.1 Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 關鍵縮寫深度解讀
blocks.en: Key Concepts: In-Depth Reading of Key Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 這些縮寫將貫穿整份技術報告，讓我們重點解讀幾個最關鍵的：
blocks.en: These abbreviations run throughout the entire technical report, so let us look closely at a few of the most important ones:

blocks.zh: PUPSIT（使用前滅菌後完整性測試）：這是近年來法規界討論最激烈的話題之一。EU GMP Annex 1（2023年生效）要求對除菌級濾膜在滅菌後、使用前進行完整性測試。這個縮寫本身就告訴你測試的時序：Pre-Use（使用前）+ Post-Sterilization（滅菌後）。
blocks.en: PUPSIT (Pre-Use Post-Sterilization Integrity Testing): This has been one of the most hotly debated topics among regulators in recent years. EU GMP Annex 1 (effective 2023) requires integrity testing of sterilizing-grade filters after sterilization and before use. The abbreviation itself tells you the timing of the test: Pre-Use + Post-Sterilization.

blocks.zh: CCS（污染控制策略）：這是 EU GMP Annex 1 引入的核心概念。除菌過濾不是獨立存在的，它是整個 CCS 的一環。你的過濾策略必須與更大的污染控制架構保持一致。
blocks.en: CCS (Contamination Control Strategy): This is a core concept introduced by EU GMP Annex 1. Sterilizing filtration does not exist in isolation; it is one element of the overall CCS. Your filtration strategy must be consistent with the larger contamination control framework.

blocks.zh: SUS（一次性使用系統）：越來越多的 CDMO 採用 Single-Use 系統，包括一次性濾器。這改變了 SIP 的需求（一次性系統通常經由 Gamma Irradiation 或 X-ray Irradiation 預滅菌，不需要 SIP）。
blocks.en: SUS (Single-Use Systems): More and more CDMOs are adopting single-use systems, including single-use filters. This changes the need for SIP (single-use systems are usually pre-sterilized by gamma irradiation or X-ray irradiation and do not require SIP).

blocks.zh: PUPSIT 就像出門前檢查瓦斯：
blocks.en: PUPSIT is like checking the gas before you leave home:

blocks.zh: 每次出門前，你都會檢查瓦斯有沒有關好。不是因為你不信任上次關瓦斯的動作，而是因為這之間可能發生了什麼你不知道的事（漏氣、閥門鬆動等）。PUPSIT 的邏輯完全相同：濾膜經過 SIP 滅菌後，在實際使用前再測一次完整性 — 確認滅菌過程沒有損壞濾膜。
blocks.en: Every time you leave home, you check whether the gas is turned off. It is not because you distrust the last time you turned it off, but because something you are unaware of (a gas leak, a loose valve, and so on) may have happened in between. PUPSIT follows exactly the same logic: after the membrane has been sterilized by SIP, its integrity is tested again just before actual use, to confirm that the sterilization process did not damage the membrane.

blocks.zh: 這個測試的爭議在於：它增加了操作複雜度和無菌風險（測試本身需要對管路進行操作），但法規認為它帶來的確認價值大於額外的風險。
blocks.en: The controversy over this test is that it adds operational complexity and sterility risk (the test itself requires manipulation of the piping), but regulators consider that the confirmation value it brings outweighs the additional risk.

blocks.zh: NOR（正常操作範圍）的驗證意義：
blocks.en: The validation significance of NOR (Normal Operating Range):

blocks.zh: NOR 定義了製程參數在正常生產中的波動範圍。在除菌過濾驗證中，你需要證明濾膜在 NOR 的邊界條件（甚至更極端的 worst-case 條件）下仍能達成除菌效果。
blocks.en: NOR defines the range over which process parameters fluctuate during normal production. In sterilizing filtration validation, you need to demonstrate that the membrane still achieves sterilization at the boundary conditions of the NOR (and even under more extreme worst-case conditions).

blocks.zh: 例如：如果你的正常過濾壓差（ΔP）範圍是 0.5-2.0 bar，你的 Bacterial Retention Study 應該至少在 2.0 bar 或更高壓差下進行測試，以涵蓋最壞情況。
blocks.en: For example: if your normal filtration differential pressure (ΔP) range is 0.5-2.0 bar, your Bacterial Retention Study should be performed at a differential pressure of at least 2.0 bar or higher to cover the worst case.

blocks.zh: TOC（總有機碳）：用於評估清洗後設備表面的殘留物。在使用可重複使用的不鏽鋼濾器外殼時，TOC 測試是清洗驗證的關鍵指標。如果改用 SUS，則不需要 TOC 清洗驗證 — 這是 Single-Use 系統的一大優勢。
blocks.en: TOC (Total Organic Carbon): Used to assess residues on equipment surfaces after cleaning. When using reusable stainless steel filter housings, TOC testing is a key indicator for cleaning validation. If you switch to SUS, TOC cleaning validation is not required, which is a major advantage of single-use systems.

blocks.zh: PUPSIT 在 EU GMP Annex 1 中被要求執行，但在 FDA 的法規框架中目前是什麼定位？如果你的 CDMO 同時供應歐美市場，你會如何制定 PUPSIT 策略？
blocks.en: PUPSIT is required by EU GMP Annex 1, but what is its position under the FDA regulatory framework today? If your CDMO supplies both the European and US markets, how would you develop a PUPSIT strategy?

blocks.zh: 如果你的工廠正在評估從傳統不鏽鋼系統轉向 SUS（一次性使用系統），這對 SIP、TOC 清洗驗證和 PUPSIT 的需求分別會有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If your site is evaluating a move from a conventional stainless steel system to SUS (single-use systems), how would this affect the need for SIP, TOC cleaning validation, and PUPSIT, respectively?

blocks.zh: CCS（污染控制策略）中，除菌過濾處於什麼位置？它與環境監測、人員管控、設備清洗等其他控制措施之間是什麼關係？
blocks.en: Where does sterilizing filtration sit within the CCS (Contamination Control Strategy)? How does it relate to other control measures such as environmental monitoring, personnel controls, and equipment cleaning?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 術語精確性是品質的基礎：TR 26 的術語表確保了全文中每個概念的定義一致性。在 CDMO 的日常工作中，術語的精確使用直接影響溝通效率和文件品質
blocks.en: Terminological precision is the foundation of quality: The TR 26 glossary ensures a consistent definition of every concept throughout the document. In day-to-day CDMO work, the precise use of terminology directly affects communication efficiency and documentation quality

blocks.zh: 核心區分：Double Filtration（兩支都需通過完整性測試）vs Redundant Filtration（第二支是備援）— 這個區別直接影響批次放行決策
blocks.en: Core distinction: Double Filtration (both filters must pass the integrity test) vs Redundant Filtration (the second filter is a backup) — this difference directly affects batch disposition decisions

blocks.zh: Extractable vs Leachable：前者是極端條件下的「最壞情況」，後者是正常使用條件下的「實際情況」。E&L 研究是濾膜選型的必要步驟
blocks.en: Extractable vs Leachable: The former is the "worst case" under extreme conditions, while the latter is the "actual case" under normal use conditions. E&L studies are a necessary step in membrane selection

blocks.zh: 壓力術語體系：ΔP = Pinlet - Poutlet，是驅動過濾的有效壓力。監控 ΔP 的變化可以判斷 Fouling（堵塞）程度
blocks.en: The pressure terminology system: ΔP = Pinlet - Poutlet is the effective pressure driving filtration. Monitoring changes in ΔP can indicate the degree of fouling

blocks.zh: 完整性測試（Integrity Test）：非破壞性物理測試，與細菌截留能力相關聯。PUPSIT 是 EU GMP Annex 1 的新要求，代表「使用前滅菌後完整性測試」
blocks.en: Integrity Test: A non-destructive physical test correlated with bacterial retention capability. PUPSIT is a new requirement of EU GMP Annex 1 and stands for "pre-use post-sterilization integrity testing"

blocks.zh: Hydrophilic vs Hydrophobic：親水性濾膜用於水溶液（大多數注射劑），疏水性濾膜用於氣體過濾和非水溶劑 — 選擇正確的類型是過濾設計的第一步
blocks.en: Hydrophilic vs Hydrophobic: Hydrophilic membranes are used for aqueous solutions (most injectables), and hydrophobic membranes for gas filtration and non-aqueous solvents. Choosing the correct type is the first step in filtration design
